description: Single source of truth for the cua-driver Windows test harness. Consumed by both the C# host apps (at startup, to set window titles / AutomationIds) and by Rust integration tests (to assert expected tree shape without hardcoding strings).

scenarios.description: Plain button increments a counter. Tests UIA Invoke pattern + label refresh.
Multi-line TextBlock with a known content hash. Tests get_window_state text extraction and screenshot OCR-ability.
MessageBox.Show with OK/Cancel. Tests modal-dialog detection and popup-window enumeration.
Bottom button strip (Save/Cancel) mimicking LO Document Recovery. Tests GetWindowRect-vs-GetClientRect capture boundary (previously cropped the strip).
Native Win32 child HWND (CreateWindowEx BUTTON) hosted inside the WPF window via HwndHost. Tests UIA descent into non-WPF child HWNDs.
Owned secondary Window (Owner set). Tests window enumeration follows ownership chain and capture targets the right HWND.
WS_EX_LAYERED window with alpha. Tests PrintWindow against layered windows (some surfaces render black without WGC fallback).
Ctrl+Shift+H increments the counter via KeyBinding. Tests foreground letter delivery through press_key / hotkey and background refusal behavior.
TextBox whose content is mirrored to a label. Tests type_text via AXSetAttribute / SendKeys to a backgrounded input.
Target Border that records left-click count, double-click, and right-click via separate labels. Tests right_click and double_click tools.
WPF Slider with ValuePattern. Drives the drag tool (from thumb to a target X) and set_value tool (UIA RangeValue / Value).
CheckBox + RadioButton group. Drives click via UIA Invoke / TogglePattern. State mirrored to a label.
ComboBox with named items. Drives selection via click + set_value.
ListBox with named items. Tests UIA SelectionPattern.
Top-level Menu + a Button with ContextMenu. Drives MenuItem invocation via click; right-click target for ContextMenu opening.
ScrollViewer with a tall body and a label that reflects VerticalOffset. Tests scroll tool delivery to a backgrounded window.
Exit button for clean teardown.

webview.description: WPF host with Microsoft.Edge.WebView2 control. Loads shared/web/index.html. Exposes Chromium DevTools Protocol at default_cdp_port for cua-driver's `page` tool.

electron.description: Electron host loading the same shared/web/index.html as the WebView harness. Exposes CDP at default_cdp_port via --remote-debugging-port.

scenarios.description: WinUI3 Button that records left-click count, double-click, and right-click via separate labels. Tests the right_click and double_click tools (Click fires per tap; timing promotes the second to double_click, RightTapped covers secondary clicks).

ScrollViewer with a tall body and a label that reflects VerticalOffset. The window subclasses its HWND to translate the driver's posted WM_VSCROLL into ChangeView (WinUI3 composition input does not consume WM_VSCROLL natively). Tests the scroll tool against a backgrounded window.
CommandBarFlyout (popup with command items). Tests flyout enumeration on WinUI3 with DirectComposition rendering.
Popup (XAML primitive, NOT a separate HWND). Tests UIA descent into XAML popup hosted in the same window.
NSButton increments NSTextField counter. Tests AXPress on a Cocoa NSButton (no flash, background-dispatch).
NSTextField (label mode) with a shared marker. Tests get_window_state text extraction from a Cocoa label.
Editable NSTextField with a mirror label. Tests type_text and set_value via AXValue on AppKit.

Five editable NSTextFields that differ only in what the app does with its own end-of-edit: txt-reformat keeps the value and rewrites it ([value]), txt-swap replaces the control with a fresh instance holding the value, txt-discard puts its own value back (keep-me), txt-confirm advertises AXConfirm and takes its commit from that action alone (confirm_typed= counts field-editor keystrokes), txt-nonbmp starts holding a non-BMP value whose UTF-16 length exceeds its character count. One lbl-end-of-edit label publishes all five commit states.

Real NSButton (AX-addressable) records click / double_click / right_click. AXPress (element_index) fires the single-click path; a pixel double-click sets double_click; right-click sets right_click. last_action= + clicks= labels.
Horizontal NSSlider (0..100). Tests drag / set_value via AXValue. slider_value= label.
NSButton checkbox. Tests click toggling AXValue. agreed= label.
NSButton with an attached NSMenu (Cut/Copy/Paste). Right-click opens the native context menu; selecting an item sets menu_action=. menu_action= label.
NSScrollView with a tall NSTextView body between SCROLL_TOP/BOTTOM markers and an offset label. Tests scroll tool delivery. scroll_offset= label.
Mac-specific: app menu item with a known title. Tests menubar enumeration via AX (the macOS main menu lives in the menubar, not the window's UIA tree).

Which control holds keyboard focus, and a row that cannot take it. The window publishes its own first responder as first_responder=<accessibility identifier> (AppKit posts no notification for it and the AX tree carries no AXFocused column). txt-row-name is the list/table name-cell shape: role AXTextField, a value and an advertised AXConfirm, never first responder, so the AXFocused write is accepted and changes nothing. With CUA_APPKIT_REMEMBERED_RESPONDER=1 the window installs the selection table as its first responder on becoming key, so txt-input starts unfocused. Tests that a text insert takes focus before writing, and that an insert at a row that cannot take focus reports nothing landed rather than a retryable partial.

A control the application reports AXEnabled=false until its window is key, in a real NSToolbar. With CUA_APPKIT_KEY_GATED_TOOLBAR=1 the window gets the toolbar; paired with CUA_APPKIT_SECOND_KEY_WINDOW=1 the harness window starts on screen and front in its own process but not key, so search-toolbar reads disabled — the Notes toolbar-search shape. Tests that a background click is refused with element_disabled and that a foreground click succeeds instead of refusing on an enabled read taken before the activation landed.

NSDatePicker (CUA_APPKIT_DATE_PICKER=1), seeded from local calendar components to 2026-09-25 17:00 so the wall clock it shows is identical on every machine. Its AXValue is a CFDate, not a string, and it advertises AXIncrement/AXDecrement: tests that the tree renders the date as a local ISO-8601 date-time and says whether AXValue is settable, so a caller can tell a write from a step without attempting one. date_value= label publishes what the app itself reads.

A button that puts an app-modal NSAlert up on the next turn of the run loop (CUA_APPKIT_MODAL_ALERT=1). The alert is a top-level AXWindow with subrole AXDialog that reports AXModal=true, not a sheet attached to the harness window, so nothing in the process accepts input until it is dismissed. Tests that the observation of the blocked window contains the dialog and its buttons, and that the window roster labels the dialog kind app-modal. modal_alert= label records which button dismissed it.

CUA_APPKIT_MENU_POPOVER=1 adds an NSPopUpButton whose AXPress opens a native NSMenu, and a button that shows a 320x460 NSPopover anchored at the window's trailing edge so the popover hangs past the window's right edge. The menu is an accessory window outside the window's AX subtree and the popover is a same-process window the window server draws with the window: tests that a press that opened a menu is reported as delivery instead of suspected_noop and that the menu is in the window's tree, and that a capture taken while the popover is open reports the rect its pixels actually cover instead of the window's own frame. popup_choice= label records the option chosen.

CUA_APPKIT_CHILD_EDITOR=1 opens a borderless child window drawn inside the main window's frame, holding a text field that takes key at launch; =sheet also begins an attached sheet. Accessibility publishes the child window AS ITS TEXT FIELD (role AXTextField, mapped by _AXUIElementGetWindow, no AXWindow/AXTopLevelUIElement attribute, AXParent = the application), which is Finder's inline rename editor shape: nothing can address, activate or make that surface key, and making the main window key dismisses it. Tests that a window-scoped background type and press_key at the MAIN window reach the editor instead of being refused as a second keyboard destination, that a foreground chord at the main window does not dismiss it, that a set_value on the editor element addressed at the main window is not refused as outside that window, and — with =sheet — that an attached sheet is still counted as a keyboard destination of its own. The editor is not in the main window's subtree, so child_editor= / child_value= / child_committed= labels in the main window publish its state; Return commits and closes it.
SwiftUI .popover() — SwiftUI's analogue of WinUI3 CommandBarFlyout / XAML Popup. Tests popover/flyout enumeration via AX (a separate AX subtree, but same NSWindow).

SwiftUI Button (AX-addressable). Tap fires click; a pixel double-tap sets double_click. NOTE: SwiftUI/AX has no distinct right-press action, so right_click on the button coerces to a normal AXPress (records click) — right-click semantics are covered by the dedicated context_menu scenario. last_action= + clicks= labels.
SwiftUI Slider (0..100). Tests drag / set_value via AXValue. slider_value= label.
SwiftUI Toggle (.checkbox style). Tests click toggling AXValue. agreed= label.
SwiftUI Button with .contextMenu (Cut/Copy/Paste). Right-click opens the context menu; selecting an item sets menu_action=. menu_action= label.
SwiftUI ScrollView with a tall body between SCROLL_TOP/BOTTOM markers and a GeometryReader-tracked offset label. Tests scroll tool delivery. scroll_offset= label.

gtk3.id_contract_note: Linux AT-SPI exposes element NAME (rendered as `[idx] role "name"`), not an AutomationId/AX-id. Each actionable control sets its accessible NAME to the aid below; marker labels carry their marker text. Tests match on name via ax::element_index_containing, not ax::has_id.

scenarios.description: GtkPopover — GTK analogue of SwiftUI .popover() / WinUI3 CommandBarFlyout. Tests popover enumeration via AT-SPI.
Button recording left/right/double clicks. last_action= + clicks= labels.
Horizontal GtkScale. slider_value= label. NOTE: GtkScale role not surfaced by cua-driver Linux get_window_state — drive via pixel coords.
Checkbox. agreed= label.
Right-click opens a GtkMenu (Cut/Copy/Paste). menu_action= label.
Tall GtkScrolledWindow between SCROLL_TOP/BOTTOM markers. scroll_offset= label. NOTE: ScrolledWindow role not surfaced by Linux get_window_state — drive via pixel coords.
